description: The inventory groups drinking-water technologies by the community capacity needed to operate them. Capacity Requirement Level classifies options for water supply unit processes and can inform technology-selection scenarios. This resource is provided by Ali Bouabid. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This is an individual research inventory. The description says five unit processes but lists only four; the review does not resolve that inconsistency. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
